Problem: Wrong mask for HASH_SR_NBWE
Context: repo=cmsis_device_u5, mcu_series=None, board=None, component=None, layer=Other, issue_kind=bug_report, severity=medium, evidence_strength=high, rescue_applied=False, state=closed, issue_number=6
Root cause: Hi @Olstyle, Looks you're right.
Fix: Found in https://github.
Constraints: Validate against exact MCU/board configuration and CubeMX/CubeH7 version before applying.
Keywords: bug_report, medium, bug, cmsis, internal bug tracker, hash, HASH_SR_NBWE, FUL, HASH_SR_NBWE_Pos

Technical details:
Found in https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/cmsis-device-u5/blob/00779e352e24435e0c7fc3b14b2416076216837b/Include/stm32u585xx.h#L6014 But the other devices are probably wrong too. HASH_SR_NBWE has 5 bits according to the datasheet (and they are really needed since it can hold up to the value 0x11) Corect mask is (0x**1**FUL << HASH_SR_NBWE_Pos) or 0x00**1**F0000 instead of (0x1FUL << HASH_SR_NBWE_Pos) or 0x000F0000.

Key comments:
Hi @Olstyle, Looks you're right. Thank you for the heads up. I'll let our development teams know in order to fix this. ST Internal Reference: 206641 Fixed in commit 1605b67aba5956fc114025ee7ffea654a9890ab9

Problem: Incorrect JPEG register definitions
Context: repo=cmsis_device_u5, mcu_series=None, board=None, component=None, layer=Other, issue_kind=bug_report, severity=medium, evidence_strength=high, rescue_applied=False, state=closed, issue_number=5
Root cause: ST Internal Reference: 201981 Fixed in Commit: https://github.
Fix: In stm32u5g9xx.
Constraints: Validate against exact MCU/board configuration and CubeMX/CubeH7 version before applying.
Keywords: bug_report, medium, bug, cmsis, internal bug tracker, jpeg, JPEG_BASE_S, AHB1PERIPH_BASE_S, JPEG_CFR_CEOCF_Pos, JPEG_CFR_CHPDF_Pos

Technical details:
In stm32u5g9xx.h (and maybe in more files), there are a few incorrect definitions: c #define JPEG_BASE_S (AHB1PERIPH_BASE_S + 0x0A00UL) #define JPEG_CFR_CEOCF_Pos (4U) #define JPEG_CFR_CHPDF_Pos (5U) They should be: c #define JPEG_BASE_S (AHB1PERIPH_BASE_S + 0x0A000UL) #define JPEG_CFR_CEOCF_Pos (5U) #define JPEG_CFR_CHPDF_Pos (6U)

Key comments:
ST Internal Reference: 201981 Fixed in Commit: https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/cmsis-device-u5/commit/00779e352e24435e0c7fc3b14b2416076216837b

Problem: Wrong VREFBUF voltage scale #define

Fix: In the stm32u5xxxx.
Constraints: Validate against exact MCU/board configuration and CubeMX/CubeH7 version before applying.
Keywords: LL, bug_report, medium, bug, cmsis, internal bug tracker, VREFBUF, LL_VREFBUF_VOLTAGE_SCALE3, VREFBUF_CSR_VRS_2, VREF_OUT4, VREFBUF_CSR_VRS_Pos
